summary: Enum-default paths were resolved from the derive-generated implementation module instead of the message's enclosing module. Adding super:: compensates for that extra module level. The implementation reversal is exact and unique. However, the added protobuf fixtures expose a compilation error before the existing packages::test in package tests can execute. No existing runtime test demonstrating this regression was found; test is empty because compilation failures do not satisfy the confirmation gate. No builds or tests were run.
